comment.body: Thanks for the concrete Beekeeper Studio install/search sequence and the observation that restarting PowerToys, not Windows, restored it. Current Program discovery uses filesystem watchers, but the report is from 0.86. Please repeat on latest stable before restarting PowerToys; if the app is still absent, add `/bugreport` immediately after the failed search and note whether Beekeeper was installed per-user or per-machine. This will distinguish stale watcher state from an installation-scope mismatch.
